text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — commits, checklist and screenshots still don't meet the feedback**

New: Squashed the fixup commits down to two. Missing: the commit titles are unchanged ("fix for issue 17419", "added test case for issue 17418" with the wrong issue number), the test is still a separate commit from the fix, and the description still has the modified self-review checklist. The before/after screenshots also still aren't precise, and the author argues they aren't needed.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm, who gave the feedback, follow up.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing! The commit messages still read "fix for issue 17419" and "added test case for issue 17418", so please rewrite them per the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) (area prefix, clear summary, explanation of why) and put the test in the same commit as the fix. Please also restore the template's self-review checklist, and show a precise before/after of the same input with tabs visible (as in your editor view), following the [screenshot guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
